mismatch.message: unsupported level change: makelevel: load_special() has no loader for special level "Wiz-loca"

summary: At recorded step 780, key z selects Wiz-loca from the wizard level-teleport menu. init_dungeons() gives the Wizard role's x-loca record the proto Wiz-loca; mklev.c makelevel() dispatches Is_special() through makemaz(), and sp_lev.c load_special() evaluates the whole Wiz-loca.lua chunk. The JavaScript path reaches mklev.js makelevel(), but ensureSpecialLevelLoaders() merges QUEST_LEVEL_LOADERS without a Wiz-loca entry, so it throws before any level terrain, regions, doors, stairs, objects, traps, or monsters are created. The Lua port belongs beside the existing quest loaders in js/quest_levels.js and should register Wiz-loca. createSpecialLevelApi() already exposes every des operation this chunk uses; its two math.random(1, 3) wall choices must consume the source rn2(3) facade. The map is 76 columns by 21 rows.

source.branch: Whole top-level chunk: solidfill and mazelevel/hardfloor flags; a 76x21 map; three probabilistic terrain replacements; five irregular regions with secret doors; four fixed locked doors; up and down stairs; a full non-diggable selection; 15 random objects; 21 fixed or random traps; and 27 monsters.
callers: js/dungeon.js fixup_level_locations() (2038-2058) resolves x-loca to the role-specific Wiz-loca proto
js/mklev.js makelevel() (627-658) detects the special level and dispatches to makemaz()
js/mklev.js makemaz() (1771-1799) resolves the proto and calls load_special()
js/mklev.js ensureSpecialLevelLoaders() (1703-1740) merges QUEST_LEVEL_LOADERS into the registry
js/mklev.js load_special() (1743-1768) looks up and runs the registered level loader
dependencies: js/mklev.js createSpecialLevelApi() des adapters for level_init, level_flags, map, replace_terrain, region, door, terrain, stair, non_diggable, object, trap, and monster
js/quest_levels.js existing quest-level loader conventions and QUEST_LEVEL_LOADERS registry
